title: Missing Patient Family Name Element
guidance: Missing family name. Provide at least a patient given and/or family name.  If neither are available, enter a reason that the name is not available. Please correct in the EHR and re-submit.

rules.regex: zzz

title: Missing Patient Given Name Element
guidance: Missing given name. The patient record does not include a given name.  Provide at least a patient given and/or family name.  If neither are available, enter a reason that the name is not available. Please correct in the EHR and re-submit.

rules.regex: zzz

title: Missing Valid Patient Gender Code
guidance: Invalid patient gender value. Please update the gender using a male or female value from the HL7 Administrative Gender Value Set: http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/administrative-gender. If you believe this is a data entry issue that can/should be rectified by a user in the EHR, please resolve and re-submit. For all other inquiries, please submit an NHSN ServiceNow ticket.

rules.regex: The value provided \('[^']*'\) was not found in the value set 'AdministrativeGender' \(http://hl7\.org/fhir/ValueSet/administrative-gender\|[^)]+\)

title: Missing Patient Gender Element
guidance: Missing patient gender. The patient's gender was not provided. Please add a gender value of male or female from the HL7 Administrative Gender Value Set: http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/administrative-gender. If you believe this is a data entry issue that can/should be rectified by a user in the EHR, please resolve and re-submit. For all other inquiries, please submit an NHSN ServiceNow ticket.

rules.regex: Patient\.gender: minimum required = 1, but only found 0

title: Missing Patient Birth Date Element
guidance: Missing patient date of birth (DOB).  Please provide the data in the form at of YYYY/MM/DD. If you believe this is a data entry issue that can/should be rectified by a user in the EHR, please resolve and re-submit. For all other inquiries, please submit an NHSN ServiceNow ticket.

rules.regex: Patient\.birthDate: minimum required = 1, but only found 0

title: Missing Valid Format for Patient Birth Date Element
guidance: Invalid date of birth (DOB) format. Please enter the DOB in YYYY/MM/DD format. If you believe this is a data entry issue that can/should be rectified by a user in the EHR, please resolve and re-submit. For all other inquiries, please submit an NHSN ServiceNow ticket.

rules.regex: Not a valid date/time format: '[^']*'
Bundle\.entry\[\d+\]\.resource.*Patient.*\.birthDate

title: Missing Patient Deceased Boolean Element
guidance: Missing patient's date of death status. If the patient is deceased, please enter the date of death in YYYY/MM/DD format or indicate whether the patient is deceased by supplying a true or false value. If you believe this is a data entry issue that can/should be rectified by a user in the EHR, please resolve and re-submit. For all other inquiries, please submit an NHSN ServiceNow ticket.

rules.regex: zzz

title: Missing Valid Format for Patient Deceased Date Element
guidance: Invalid patient date of death format. Please enter the date of death in YYYY/MM/DD format. If you believe this is a data entry issue that can/should be rectified by a user in the EHR, please resolve and re-submit. For all other inquiries, please submit an NHSN ServiceNow ticket.

rules.regex: Not a valid date/time format: '[^']*'
Bundle\.entry\[\d+\]\.resource.*Patient.*\.deceased(?:\[x\])?(?:DateTime)?(?:\.ofType\(dateTime\))?

title: Missing Valid Specimen type Code
guidance: Invalid specimen type code. Please specify the kind of material collected (for example, blood, urine, or tissue) by providing a valid code  from Specimen Type: https://vsac.nlm.nih.gov/valueset/2.16.840.1.113762.1.4.1099.54/expansion. If an applicable SNOMED-CT code  exists, the code must be used and sent. If you believe this is a data entry issue that can/should be rectified by a user in the EHR, please resolve and re-submit. For all other inquiries, please submit an NHSN ServiceNow ticket.

rules.regex: None of the codings provided are in the value set 'Specimen type' \(http://cts\.nlm\.nih\.gov/fhir/ValueSet/2\.16\.840\.1\.113762\.1\.4\.1099\.54\|[^)]+\), and a coding from this value set is required\) \(codes = [^)]+\)

title: Missing Specimen type Element
guidance: Missing specimen type code. Please specify the kind of material collected (for example, blood, urine, or tissue) by providing a valid code  from Specimen Type: https://vsac.nlm.nih.gov/valueset/2.16.840.1.113762.1.4.1099.54/expansion.  If an applicable SNOMED-CT code  exists, the code must be used and sent. If you believe this is a data entry issue that can/should be rectified by a user in the EHR, please resolve and re-submit. For all other inquiries, please submit an NHSN ServiceNow ticket.

rules.regex: Specimen\.type: minimum required = 1, but only found 0

title: Missing Valid Format for Specimen Collection Collected Element
guidance: Invalid format for Specimen.collection.collected or period. Correct the date/time values in Encounter.period to use the format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss+zz:zz. If both a start and end date/time are provided, make sure the start occurs before the end. If you believe this is a data entry issue that can/should be rectified by a user in the EHR, please resolve and re-submit. For all other inquiries, please submit an NHSN ServiceNow ticket.

rules.regex: Not a valid date/time format: '[^']*'
Bundle\.entry\[\d+\]\.resource.*Specimen.*\.collection\.collected(?:\[x\])?(?:\.ofType\(dateTime\))?

title: Missing Specimen Collection Collected Element
guidance: Missing Specimen.collection.collected datetime or period. Enter a valid date time or period for Specimen.collection.collected. Provide the start/date time and, if applicable, the end date/time in the format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss+zz:zz. When both are provided, the start date/time must occur before the end date/time. If you believe this is a data entry issue that can/should be rectified by a user in the EHR, please resolve and re-submit. For all other inquiries, please submit an NHSN ServiceNow ticket.

rules.regex: Specimen\.collection\.collected: minimum required = 1, but only found 0

title: Missing Specimen Subject Element
guidance: Missing Specimen.subject reference. Provide the URL reference to the patient. If you believe this is a data entry issue that can/should be rectified by a user in the EHR, please resolve and re-submit. For all other inquiries, please submit an NHSN ServiceNow ticket.

rules.regex: Specimen\.subject\.reference: minimum required = 1, but only found 0

title: Missing Specimen accessionIdentifier Element
guidance: Missing an accession identifier assigned by the laboratory. Please add the accession identifier (Specimen.accessionIdentifier) to help uniquely identify and track the specimen. If you believe this is a data entry issue that can/should be rectified by a user in the EHR, please resolve and re-submit. For all other inquiries, please submit an NHSN ServiceNow ticket.
